name: walter19
caption:
PICK 19 🎮🏀 Hurt before his first camp. Sent down to the 905. Now he's playing real minutes.

• 2024 draft: we take Ja'Kobe Walter at #19, then he misses training camp hurt
• March 4, 2025: game-winning three at Orlando with 0.5 seconds left
• 2025-26: 40.9% from three. Playoffs: 24 points in an OT win over Cleveland
• First 9 games this season: 10.9 PPG in 29.1 minutes, 22 at Minnesota

Keeper or trade chip? 👇

facts.claim: June 26, 2024: Walter selected #19 (19th overall) by Toronto; missed the start of the season including training camp with an AC joint sprain and was assigned several times to Raptors 905; March 4, 2025: game-winning three with 0.5 seconds left in a 114-113 win at Orlando; May 1, 2026: playoff career-high 24 points in a 112-110 overtime (OT) win against Cleveland
